new_stories.scope: Opportunity evaluation now; persisted watch/inbox later, not delivered

rules.1: Same owner TripRequest and same currency; verified complete price only.
rules.2: Durable notification dedupe watch/observation and atomic outbox remain required when activated.
rules.3: Pause/cancel, owner isolation and expiry remain mandatory.

ac.1: ACTIVE watch matching fresh complete observation creates exactly one inbox and outbox atomically (BLOCKED).
ac.2: Repeated observation creates no duplicate notification/outbox (BLOCKED).
ac.3: PAUSED/CANCELLED or partial/stale/different currency observation creates no notification (BLOCKED).
ac.4: Other owner denied; repeated acknowledgement preserves read_at (BLOCKED except owner infrastructure).
ac.5: Given existing selected flight and user Money threshold When owner evaluates Then fresh verified same-currency price is MATCH iff <= threshold; otherwise NO_MATCH, NOT_VERIFIED or CURRENCY_MISMATCH; no notification or price guarantee.
